title: PostgreSQL Connection Troubleshooting
content: Application cannot connect to the database or reports connection timeouts. Check PostgreSQL availability, hostname, port 5432, DNS resolution, firewall rules and credentials. Inspect connection pool usage and database connection limits before changing settings.

title: Staging Database Connection Checks
content: Staging application cannot connect to PostgreSQL. Verify the staging database endpoint, credentials, DNS and network access. Check whether the database is stopped and confirm the application uses staging secrets.

title: Kubernetes Pod Restart Troubleshooting
content: A container keeps restarting or shows CrashLoopBackOff. Inspect kubectl describe pod, pod events and previous container logs. Check exit codes, OOMKilled events, memory limits and liveness probes before deciding on a fix.

title: Staging Container Memory Troubleshooting
content: A staging pod is killed after using too much memory. Check OOMKilled events, memory metrics and configured resource limits. Investigate memory leaks and workload size before increasing memory allocation.

title: TLS Certificate Renewal
content: Users see an expired certificate warning when opening the website. Check certificate expiry, hostname coverage and the certificate chain. Renew through the certificate provider and verify the new certificate is served by the load balancer.

title: Staging DNS Troubleshooting
content: A staging hostname does not resolve or points to the wrong IP address. Check DNS records with dig or nslookup, the configured resolver and recent record changes. Compare authoritative responses and cached answers.
